source.section: Line 8 minimum tax, 3% of federal AGI over 150,000 (booklet PDF p.11 Line 8; PDF p.46 note); Schedule IN-112 Part I Line 14, Railroad Retirement (IN-112 Instructions PDF p.4 Line 14; booklet PDF p.23); Form IN-111 Lines 1-8 and 14 (booklet PDF pp.10-11), standard deduction chart and Lines 4-5e (PDF p.11), rate schedules (PDF p.46)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = IRA distribution (person 0) 40,060.00 + Railroad Retirement Tier 2 annuity (person 0) 109,940.00 = 150,000.00. Federal taxable income = 150,000.00 - 15,750.00 federal standard deduction - 1 x 2,000.00 age 65 additional = 132,250.00 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form IN-111, Single: Line 1 federal AGI 150,000.00. Schedule IN-112 Part I: Line 1 all state and local obligation interest 0.00; Line 2 Vermont obligations 0.00; Line 3 = 0.00; Line 4 0.00; Line 6 total additions 0.00. Subtractions: Line 14 Railroad Retirement 109,940.00; Line 18 total subtractions 109,940.00. Line 19 net modifications = 0.00 - 109,940.00 = -109,940.00. Form IN-111 Line 2 -109,940.00; Line 3 = 150,000.00 + (-109,940.00) = 40,060.00. Line 4 standard deduction 7,650.00 + 1 x 1,250.00 age box(es) = 8,900.00 [person 0 born 1959-09-19 (65 or older: box checked)]. Line 5a-5d personal exemptions 1; Line 5e 1 x 5,300.00 = 5,300.00. Line 6 = 8,900.00 + 5,300.00 = 14,200.00. Line 7 Vermont taxable income = 40,060.00 - 14,200.00 = 25,860.00. Line 8: schedule tax on 25,860.00 (Schedule X, booklet p.46, merged continuous schedule): 3.35% x (25,860.00 - 0.00) = 866.31; the tax table (pp.47-51) gives 866. Federal AGI 150,000.00 is not greater than 150,000.00, so no minimum tax (3% of AGI would be 4,500.00): Line 8 866.31. Line 9 0.00 (no Schedule IN-119 items; Credit for the Elderly or the Disabled not modelled); Line 10 866.31; Lines 11-13 0.00; Line 14 Vermont income tax 866.31.
accepted_approximations: The rate schedule is one continuous schedule: the printed rows that restart at 75,000 are merged and printed base taxes, rounded to the dollar, are not used. Below 75,000 the booklet uses tax tables in 100 dollar rows.
